items.cssText: .yssa-state-card{--a:#8d72e8;box-sizing:border-box;padding:16px;border:1px solid rgba(141,114,232,.28);border-radius:20px;color:#f7f3ff;background:radial-gradient(circle at 95% 0,rgba(141,114,232,.28),transparent 40%),linear-gradient(145deg,#171421,#211a31);box-shadow:0 14px 35px rgba(16,10,32,.28);font:14px/1.55 system-ui,sans-serif}.yssa-state-card *{box-sizing:border-box}.yssa-state-card header,.yssa-state-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.yssa-state-card h2{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:21px}.yssa-state-card small{color:#bdb1e4;letter-spacing:.08em}.yssa-state-card header>span{padding:5px 10px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(141,114,232,.2)}.yssa-state-meta{justify-content:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:13px 0;color:#d9d0f4}.yssa-state-meta b{font-weight:500}.yssa-state-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.yssa-state-grid article,.yssa-state-wide,.yssa-state-card footer{padding:11px;border-radius:13px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}.yssa-state-card p{margin:4px 0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.yssa-state-wide,.yssa-state-card footer{margin-top:8px}.yssa-state-card footer{border-left:3px solid var(--a)}.yssa-state-card em{color:#aaa1bf;font-size:12px}@media(max-width:420px){.yssa-state-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
items.promptTemplate: 根据最近剧情生成当前状态。只输出 JSON 对象，不要 Markdown，不要解释。字段必须完整：{"chapter":"章节或场景标题","time":"剧情时间","location":"地点","weather":"天气或环境","participants":"在场角色","objective":"当前目标","tension":"平静/微妙/紧张/危险","relationship":"主要关系气氛","condition":"主角身体与情绪","items":"关键持有物","clues":"已确认线索","next":"最值得推进的一件事","note":"不确定信息或风险"}。只写剧情已经支持的事实；无法确认就写未知。

initialState.note: 在魔坊中手动更新，不会自动请求 API。

items.cssText: .yssa-investigation{box-sizing:border-box;padding:17px;border-radius:18px;color:#f7eee9;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#281a1c,#171419);border:1px solid rgba(221,134,105,.28);font:14px/1.55 system-ui,sans-serif}.yssa-investigation *{box-sizing:border-box}.yssa-investigation header{position:relative;padding-left:13px;border-left:3px solid #d98267}.yssa-investigation h2{margin:2px 0;font-size:22px}.yssa-investigation small,.yssa-investigation em{color:#c7a69b}.yssa-investigation blockquote{margin:13px 0;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(217,130,103,.1)}.yssa-investigation>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.yssa-investigation article,.yssa-investigation footer{padding:11px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}.yssa-investigation p{margin:4px 0;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.yssa-investigation footer{margin-top:8px}.yssa-investigation em{display:block;font-size:11px}@media(max-width:420px){.yssa-investigation>div{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
items.promptTemplate: 选择当前剧情中的一名角色，做一次严谨的大调查。只输出 JSON 对象，不要 Markdown，不要解释：{"title":"报告标题","target":"调查对象","conclusion":"一句话结论","profile":"人物侧写","relationship":"与用户及重要角色的关系","evidence":"有剧情依据的证据，用分号分隔","secrets":"秘密与疑点，用分号分隔","uncertainties":"无法确认的部分","recommendation":"下一步调查或互动建议","updatedAt":"剧情内时间"}。推测必须放进 uncertainties，不能伪装成事实。

initialState.title: 尚未调查
initialState.conclusion: 在魔坊中手动生成调查报告。

items.name: 剧情成就册
items.cssText: .yssa-achievements{box-sizing:border-box;padding:16px;border-radius:20px;color:#fff8df;background:radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0,rgba(244,191,85,.2),transparent 38%),#211c19;border:1px solid rgba(244,191,85,.24);font:14px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif}.yssa-achievements *{box-sizing:border-box}.yssa-achievements header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.yssa-achievements h2{margin:2px 0}.yssa-achievements header>b{font-size:28px;color:#f4bf55}.yssa-achievements small{color:#cdbb8f}.yssa-achievements-latest{padding:8px 10px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(244,191,85,.1)}.yssa-achievements>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.yssa-achievements article{position:relative;padding:12px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.055)}.yssa-achievements article>span{position:absolute;right:9px;top:7px;color:rgba(244,191,85,.35);font-size:20px;font-weight:800}.yssa-achievements h3{margin:0 26px 4px 0;font-size:15px}.yssa-achievements p{margin:0 0 5px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.yssa-achievements footer{margin-top:10px;color:#e4cf99}@media(max-width:420px){.yssa-achievements>div{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
items.promptTemplate: 整理当前剧情已经完成的四个代表性成就。只输出 JSON 对象，不要 Markdown，不要解释。字段：total 为已达成总数，latest 为最新成就名，a1Name/a1Desc/a1Time 到 a4Name/a4Desc/a4Time 为四个成就，progress 为尚未完成但已显露的目标。不得把计划或猜测写成已达成。

items.name: 社交笔记墙
items.cssText: .yssa-social{box-sizing:border-box;padding:15px;border-radius:20px;color:#32292d;background:#fffafb;border:1px solid #f0dfe4;font:14px/1.55 system-ui,sans-serif}.yssa-social *{box-sizing:border-box}.yssa-social header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}.yssa-social-avatar{display:grid;width:44px;height:44px;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#ff718e,#f3b15e);color:white;font-size:20px}.yssa-social h2{margin:0;font-size:18px}.yssa-social header small{color:#927f86}.yssa-social article{margin:8px 0;padding:13px;border-radius:14px;background:white;box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(77,38,52,.07)}.yssa-social article>span{display:inline-block;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:99px;background:#fff0f3;color:#cf5870;font-size:11px}.yssa-social h3{margin:7px 0 3px}.yssa-social p{margin:0;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.yssa-social article footer{margin-top:8px;color:#a58d95}.yssa-social-note{display:block;color:#a58d95;text-align:center}
items.promptTemplate: 根据当前剧情生成三条角色社交笔记，像真实生活分享，不要复述旁白。只输出 JSON 对象，不要 Markdown，不要解释。字段：author、handle、avatar（一个字符或表情）、bio；p1Tag/p1Title/p1Body/p1Likes/p1Comments 到 p3Tag/p3Title/p3Body/p3Likes/p3Comments；note。点赞和评论数必须符合角色影响力，不要虚构会改变主线的事实。
